name: Town Gifts
description: Friendly townsfolk who hand out gifts, all in one mod (formerly daily_gift, wonder_trader, berry_grove, daily_coins, type_sage, and starter_pack): a free item, a rare Pokemon, a healing item, and Game Corner coins each once per real week, a rotating weekly type tip, and a one-time welcome kit from a spawned NPC in Pewter that leaves for good once claimed.
